summary: AIVideosUGC turns a product photo or a product link into store images and short video ads. Choose an AI actor and get a short ad in minutes.
facts: AI tool for store images and short video ads.
Online shops, agencies, ad buyers, and one-person stores. They post on Shopify, Amazon, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook without a shoot.
6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Shapes are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4. Start from a product photo or a product link.
White-background photos, lifestyle photos, on-person photos, a new background, and social ad images. All start from a product photo.
53 AI actors in the library. You can also build a presenter from photos you are allowed to use, then reuse that presenter.
A spoken line in an AI voice, or a clone of a voice you are allowed to use. You can edit the captions and add a song from the music library.
The tool can write the spoken line from your product and a short note about the buyer. You can rewrite any word.
The actor can say the line in more than one language. You pick the language when you make the video.
Shorten the clip, swap the actor, change the line, and fix captions in the tool. No second app required.
Send a finished file to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook from the tool, or download it and post it yourself.
Your own software can start a photo or video through the API. Email support@aivideosugc.com if you need access.
Make several versions from one product photo in one batch. Each version shows its credit cost before it starts.
Plans start at $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300. Premium is $63 for 600. You see the credit cost before every photo or video.
Credits are set aside when a job starts, used when the file is delivered, and returned if it fails. A photo is 24 credits. A 6-second video is 24, 10 seconds is 40, 15 is 60, and 30 is 120.
You can use downloaded photos and videos in ads and on your store. Paid downloads have no watermark.
Uploads and results stay in the customer's account and are not public.
53 AI actors, plus a presenter you save from photos you are allowed to use.
Up to 7 reference photos on a job, so the product and the presenter can stay consistent.

faq.q: Does a video include a spoken line?
faq.a: Yes. Your video can include a spoken message, editable captions, and music. Choose an AI actor to present it without recording yourself.

faq.q: Can I start from a product page link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a public product page link to bring in its photos and details. Review the message and scene before making the ad.

faq.q: How many AI actors are in the library?
faq.a: There are 53 AI actors in the library. Choose one that fits your audience and use them again across several ads.

faq.q: What length and shape can the ad use?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds and a format such as vertical, square, or wide. You can make versions for different feeds from the same product photo.

faq.q: What can I make with AIVideosUGC?
faq.a: You can make store images and short product ads from a photo or link. Add an AI actor, voice, and captions when the message needs a presenter.

faq.q: Do I need a crew, or just a product photo?
faq.a: No crew is needed. Start with a product photo or public link, choose the message and actor, and make an ad in minutes.
Starter costs $24.50 monthly for 200 credits; Pro costs $35 for 300; Premium costs $63 for 600. You see each job’s credit cost before starting, and failed jobs return their credits.

faq.q: Do I pay before the first file?
faq.a: Yes. Choose Starter at $24.50 monthly for 200 credits, Pro at $35 for 300, or Premium at $63 for 600. You see the credit cost before each job.

faq.q: Can I make more than one version at a time?
faq.a: Yes. Make several versions from one product photo to test different messages or actors. You see the credit cost for each version before starting.

faq.q: Can I send the file to TikTok or Meta from the tool?
faq.a: Yes. You can send a finished file to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook from the tool, or download it and post it yourself.

faq.q: How many credits does a video or photo use?
faq.a: A photo costs 24 credits. A 6, 10, 15, or 30 second video costs 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits. Failed jobs return their credits.

faq.q: Can my own software start a photo or video?
faq.a: Yes. Your software can start photo or video jobs through the API. Email support@aivideosugc.com to get access.

faq.q: Do I need to choose a video model?
faq.a: No. Choose the result you want, add your product photo or link, and make the video. You can review and adjust it before posting.

faq.q: Can I reuse the same actor on the next ad?
faq.a: Yes. Choose from 53 AI actors and use the same presenter in another ad. This keeps your product videos consistent without arranging another shoot.

faq.q: Can I rebuild an ad I already run?
faq.a: Yes. Use an ad you already run as a reference, then change the opening or actor for your product. This helps you test another version quickly.

faq.q: Can the actor say the line in another language?
faq.a: Yes. Write the message in the language your customers use and choose a matching voice. You can make a new version without hiring another presenter.
AIVideosUGC turns your product photos or links into store images and short video ads. Add an AI actor and voice when you want someone to present the product.

faq.q: Can I use the results in ads and on my store?
faq.a: Yes. Download the file without a watermark for your store or paid ads. Follow each platform’s rules when you post.
